name: Coinbase Agentic Wallet
summary: Wallet tooling that lets AI agents hold, spend, trade and earn stablecoins with guardrails, via the awal CLI + skills or an MCP server.
description: Vendor-affiliated Coinbase product (real-money wallets, transfers, trades and x402 payments — none were used during verification). Two documented modes: the Agentic Wallet CLI (`npx awal`, skills via `npx skills add coinbase/agentic-wallet-skills`) and the MCP server (`npx @coinbase/payments-mcp`). Those commands were not executed. As of 2026-11-14 the former CDP docs URLs https://docs.cdp.coinbase.com/agentic-wallet/welcome and https://docs.cdp.coinbase.com/agentic-wallet/cli/skills/overview return HTTP 404, and those /agentic-wallet paths are absent from the current https://docs.cdp.coinbase.com/llms.txt. This entry is not retargeted to Coinbase Wallet MCP / wallet-mcp.coinbase.com / `npx skills add coinbase/agents --skill wallet-mcp`, which is a different product (connects to a Coinbase Wallet, formerly Base App). Still-live surfaces for this product: github.com/coinbase/agentic-wallet-skills (not archived; last pushed 2026-08-04; MIT via LICENSE.md, Copyright 2026 Coinbase; a root file named LICENSE returns 404). npm awal 2.12.2 lists Apache-2.0 (uploaded 2026-10-08); its npm homepage still points at github.com/coinbase/awal, which returned 404. npm @coinbase/payments-mcp 1.0.5 lists Apache-2.0; repo coinbase/payments-mcp exists (LICENSE present; last pushed 2025-10-22). Official deprecation of Agentic Wallet was not found; status remains active. npm web pages may be 403 and are not used as sources. No signup, wallet or spend was used.

agent_access.notes: CDP /agentic-wallet docs returned 404 on 2026-11-14 and are absent from the current CDP llms.txt (kept only as the general CDP file). Live sources are the skills and payments-mcp GitHub repos. CLI/MCP installs and any wallet or x402 calls were not run. Not Coinbase Wallet MCP.
